basePrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-resolution Sanctuary design-review board for the existing ShinKu Android manga reader. This is an image concept, not implementation. The TWO references establish the visual direction: charcoal-black background, muted lavender/periwinkle accents, warm-white text, restrained violet-gray cards with subtle thin borders, rounded corners, consistent line icons, readable Android typography and generous touch areas. Preserve the exact app spelling ShinKu. Do not introduce crimson, a new logo, subscriptions, chat assistants, fabricated provider results, credentials, or new backend functionality.
Layout: landscape 3:2 board with THREE large equal portrait Android screens, straight-on thin rounded device frames, modest gutters and a quiet dark canvas. Screen content must dominate the image and remain legible when zoomed. Small board heading at top; a compact name under each screen. Unless explicitly overridden below, use three phones. Use familiar manga artwork consistent with the references where covers are relevant. Avoid dense tiny text: show representative rows and use scroll affordances for additional content. Wrap long labels. Inner pages have a back arrow and NO home navigation dock. Only actual home tabs have the familiar five-item dock (Library, Updates, History, Browse, More), selected appropriately. Always reserve space so docks, primary actions and gesture bars do not hide content. Show truthful illustrative states, no invented performance guarantees or completed remote actions. Match both reference boards closely.

boards.title: Discovery & search

panels.name: Discover
panels.brief: Home Browse feed. Compact featured manga card, full two-line title, search action, genre chips. Horizontal shelves 'For you' and 'Recently updated', readable cover captions and 'See all'. Small explanation 'Based on your reading genres'. Tabs Feed, Sources, Extensions, Migrate remain fully readable via a scrollable tab strip. Browse selected in dock. Preserve shelf size and source controls.

panels.name: Global search
panels.brief: Back arrow, large search field containing 'fantasy', clear icon, source/language filter chips. Group results by source with source heading and See all, two or three covers per row, complete short titles. A small inline 'Searching another sourceÃ¢â‚¬Â¦' row shows partial progress without blocking available results. No home dock.

panels.name: Source catalogue
panels.brief: Back arrow, source title 'Manga source', search and filter icons; Popular and Latest tabs; three-column manga grid with legible multi-line captions, source and language context, and bottom-safe pagination loading. No brand-new recommendation engine or extra functionality.

boards.note: Preserve genre filters and full-title access; generated counts and truncated captions require review.
